_about: Prompt book for SpritePackPromptBook. Edit freely: tags in the workflow slots (slot1 = actions, slot2 = views, slot3 = style) are looked up here. 'seconds' is how long an action runs in the video, 'settle' is how long to wait before the loop finder starts looking (the character is still moving into the action), 'kind' is 'cycle' (loops: walk, run, idle) or 'oneshot' (plays once: attack, jump...).

frame_rule._note: H3 lengths are base + step*k frames; ~396 is the practical max at 512x512

_timeline_template_note: PLACEHOLDER: replace with the exact timestamp syntax H3 honours. Available fields: {start} {end} (seconds, one decimal) and {text}. Segments are joined with 'joiner'.
preamble: {subject} is the reference character. The scene is a plain pure white background, full body in frame from head to feet, static camera, flat even lighting, no shadows, no motion blur, no text. {style}

styles.pixel-white: Crisp pixel art style with hard pixel edges and a limited colour palette.
styles.toon-white: Clean 2D cartoon style with flat colours and bold outlines.

views.side: a side view with the character facing right, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.side-left: a side view with the character facing left, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.threequarter: a three-quarter front view with the character facing right, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.threequarter-left: a three-quarter front view with the character facing left, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.front: a straight front view, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.back: a straight rear view, at a fixed distance, camera level with the character
views.topdown: a high three-quarter top-down view looking down at the character, at a fixed distance

idle.text: the character stands in place in a relaxed idle pose, breathing gently with tiny natural movement, looping seamlessly

walk.text: the character walks in place at a steady pace with a smooth natural walk cycle, taking even steps without travelling across the frame

run.text: the character runs in place with a smooth even run cycle, without travelling across the frame

jump.text: the character crouches, jumps straight up and lands back in the same spot

attack.text: the character performs one strong attack and returns to a ready stance

hit.text: the character flinches back from a hit and recovers

death.text: the character collapses to the ground and lies still
